title: Captain's Quarters East Nashville, Tn (Five Point)
description:
This home is in the heart of Five Points in East Nashville, Tn. Wrap around front porch and fenced in back yard. My home has 4 bedrooms and 2 1/2 baths and a large gourmet kitchen. It has multiple fireplaces and gleaming hardwood floors throughout the house. We are within walking distance to nice restaurants, music venues and much more. Uber and Lyft accessible and only 5 minutes to Nissan Stadium, Bridgestone, The Ryman and Downtown. location, location, location.

Guest access
The entire house!

Other things to note
You may schedule a ride from the airport just let me know a little in advance. You can also have your luggage delivered to you destination before your check in time!
